review.title: Beyond the original label
review.text: The prediction extends beyond the original primary-tumor contour, following additional enhancing tissue that appears tumor-like on visual review. This is a useful example of how a model can highlight regions omitted from its training annotations.
review.detail: Compare Prediction with Training label across slices. The additional regions are candidates for review, not independently confirmed tumor; some may be false positives.

subjects.prediction_method: Full-volume 1 mm inference in a single pass; no internal crop boundaries.

review.title: Compact lesion, close diameter agreement
review.text: A small, single focal lesion with close agreement in the first two measured diameters: 30.0 vs 29.1 mm and 28.3 vs 28.2 mm for prediction vs training label.
review.detail: The overall size agrees more closely than the full contour: predicted volume is 8.69 vs 5.59 cm³. Compare the boundaries as well as the diameter values.

subjects.prediction_method: Full-volume 1 mm inference in a single pass; no internal crop boundaries.

review.title: Complex, multifocal morphology
review.text: An irregular tumor with multiple foci makes this a more demanding example than a single compact lesion. Review the dominant mass and smaller separate regions through all three planes.
review.detail: The first diameter is close to the training label (66.6 vs 65.6 mm), but that alone does not establish coverage of every focus or agreement along the irregular boundary.

subjects.prediction_method: Full-volume 1 mm inference in a single pass; no internal crop boundaries.

review.title: Broad extent and local coverage
review.text: This broad, irregular tumor is a useful stress case for spatial coverage. The saved whole-volume prediction captures much of its extent but is smaller than the training label, particularly along the second measured axis.
review.detail: For live seed inference, a single 96³-voxel crop may miss parts of the lesion. Stitching overlapping crops is a possible improvement to that tool. The saved prediction already evaluates the whole volume, so its remaining differences are not caused by a single-crop cutoff.

review.title: Main lesion captured, thin extensions weaker
review.text: The main lesion is captured reasonably well on visual review, with close overall dimensions and volume. Thinner extensions are less consistently delineated, giving the predicted contour a smoother appearance.
review.detail: Toggle the training label and inspect the narrow projections across slices. Similar total volume (8.11 vs 7.99 cm³) can still conceal meaningful local boundary differences.
